metadata.question: Did the land area of Smith Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about whether the land area of Smith Island decreased between 1999 and 2019. This requires: 1. Finding Smith Island location - likely a coastal island that might be affected by erosion/sea level rise 2. Using satellite imagery to detect land vs water in both time periods 3. Comparing the land area between the two periods Strategy: - Use Landsat imagery (Landsat 5 for 1999, Landsat 8 for 2019) - Apply water detection using NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) - Calculate land area by counting non-water pixels - Compare the two areas Data Quality Considerations: - Check collection sizes for both periods - Ensure sufficient valid pixels after cloud masking - Validate the results are reasonable I'll need to: 1. Define Smith Island location (using coordinates for a known Smith Island) 2. Get Landsat collections for both time periods 3. Apply cloud masking and water detection 4. Calculate land area for both years 5. Compare and determine if area decreased Let me implement this step by step. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Smith Island coordinates (Chesapeake Bay, Maryland/Virginia) const smithIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([-75.95, 37.95]).buffer(5000); // Define time periods const start1999 = '1999-01-01'; const end1999 = '1999-12-31'; const start2019 = '2019-01-01'; const end2019 = '2019-12-31'; // Function to mask clouds and calculate NDWI function maskCloudsAndWater(image) { // Cloud masking for Landsat const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudsBitMask = 1 << 5; const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0)); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); return image.updateMask(mask).addBands(ndwi); } // Get Landsat collections let landsat1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1999, end1999) .filterBounds(smithIsland); let landsat2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(smithIsland); // Check if collections are empty and try fallback if (landsat1999.size().getInfo() === 0) { landsat1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(start1999, end1999) .filterBounds(smithIsland); } // Process 1999 data const processed1999 = landsat1999.map(maskCloudsAndWater); const composite1999 = processed1999.median(); // Process 2019 data const processed2019 = landsat2019.map(maskCloudsAndWater); const composite2019 = processed2019.median(); // Check collection sizes const count1999 = landsat1999.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = landsat2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images: ${count1999}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count1999 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate land area (non-water pixels) const waterThreshold = 0; // Land = NDWI < threshold (negative values) const landMask1999 = composite1999.select('NDWI').lt(waterThreshold); const landMask2019 = composite2019.select('NDWI').lt(waterThreshold); // Count land pixels const landArea1999 = landMask1999.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const landArea2019 = landMask2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: smithIsland, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Land Pixels: ${Math.round(landArea1999)}`); console.log(`2019 Land Pixels: ${Math.round(landArea2019)}`); // Check for valid pixels if (landArea1999 === 0 || landArea2019 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (landArea1999 === null || landArea2019 === null || isNaN(landArea1999) || isNaN(landArea2019)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate area change const areaChange = ((landArea2019 - landArea1999) / landArea1999 * 100); console.log(`Area Change: ${areaChange.toFixed(1)}%`); // Determine answer if (landArea2019 < landArea1999) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
